abstract_sentences.text: Reasoning-based image quality assessment (IQA) models trained through reinforcement learning (RL) exhibit exceptional generalization, yet the underlying mechanisms and critical factors driving this capability remain underexplored in current research.

Moreover, despite their superior performance, these models incur inference energy usage and latency orders of magnitude higher than their earlier counterparts, restricting their deployment in specific scenarios.

evidence.anchor: energy usage and latency orders of magnitude higher

abstract_sentences.text: Through extensive experiments, this paper verifies and elaborates that through RL training, MLLMs leverage their reasoning capability to convert redundant visual representations into compact, cross-domain aligned text representations.

evidence.anchor: convert redundant visual representations into compact

abstract_sentences.text: This conversion is precisely the source of the generalization exhibited by these reasoning-based IQA models.
Building on this fundamental insight, we propose a novel algorithm, RALI, which employs contrastive learning to directly align images with these generalizable text representations learned by RL.
This approach eliminates the reliance on reasoning processes and even obviates the need to load an LLM during inference.

evidence.anchor: obviates the need to load an LLM

abstract_sentences.text: For the quality scoring task, this framework achieves generalization performance comparable to reasoning-based models while requiring less than 5% of their model parameters and inference time.

evidence.anchor: less than 5% of their model parameters and inference time

lexical_analysis.scope: p. 1–9 正文抽取文本；排除 References、页眉页脚，并人工移除大部分公式碎片、表格数值和固定图注。
lexical_analysis.count_caveat: 表格抽取会留下 case 等伪 n-gram；连字符如 cross-domain、out-of-domain 的切分影响次数。

rhetorical_patterns.location: 主体词主要在 Appendix B

lexical_analysis.interpretation: 词频由领域骨架词驱动；reasoning、text、quality、generalization 构成主线，RALI／RACT 是方法命名，限定词显著少于机制与效率主张。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 作者把 RL-based IQA 泛化重解释为 visual tokens 到 compact、cross-domain aligned quality reasoning text 的压缩；RACT 将文本用作统一跨域 label，RALI 再以 CLIP 对齐、PCA、bucketed k-means 和 score mapping 直接复现表示路径，删除多步 reasoning 与 LLM 推理。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留两项问题、Figure 2–4 的机制观察、Table 1 的跨域替换、RALI 三组件与公式 (1)–(3)、Tables 2–5 的主结果／消融和 Figure 6 的 A100 效率，形成机制 → RACT → RALI → 结果链。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix A–G 放入 reasoning removal、RACT 流程与混合域补充、prompts、超参数扫描、3B 对照、质性案例和 limitations；算法主结构仍可读，但适用域、复现粒度、统计稳定性和关键消融被推迟。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 3 的 attention 分配、Figure 4 的双 t-SNE、Table 1 的固定 Visual Encoder／替换 LLM 组合把表示主张变成可读证据，Figure 5 再把同一表示链转成四阶段工程流程。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 核心因果措辞强于识别设计：attention 与 t-SNE 是相关／布局证据，Table A.1 是整体训练策略对照，Table 4 的 case 1 还混淆两个组件；同时 memory reduction 与 Figure 6、Table 2 的 SRCC 差值存在不一致。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 用轻量 representation 替换昂贵 reasoning 时，应同时测量依赖位置、跨域表示差异、最小正交干预（删除／替代／长度控制）、逐域结果和成本曲线，并把“representation is the source”绑定到可证伪 intervention。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合小规模、标签主观性强且跨域分布差异明显的视觉质量任务；不能把 natural-image IQA 上的 t-SNE、PLCC／SRCC 和两种 score source 直接外推到 video、AIGC 或其他 MLLM。

evidence_coverage.method: 每条主张至少绑定一个 physical PDF page、section 和不超过 20 个英文词的 anchor；图表／公式编号直接作为 anchor。
